subject.title: fix(daemon/launchd): cap unbounded gateway stdout/stderr log growth (refs #79422)

question: Should macOS LaunchAgent stderr remain intentionally routed to `/dev/null`, or should OpenClaw restore a bounded supervisor stderr log and expose a supported retention policy?
rationale: Current main and this branch implement incompatible assumptions about the active stderr sink, so a mechanical rebase cannot safely choose the permanent logging and operator-support contract.

options.title: Keep stderr suppressed
options.body: Close or substantially narrow this PR because there is no active launchd stderr file to retain.

options.title: Restore bounded supervisor logs
options.body: Adopt a current-main design that writes the approved supervisor streams to the current log family and rotates only those streams with documented upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause for daemon logging design
options.body: Defer the branch until the macOS logging/diagnostics policy is decided alongside the open stderr-routing work.

recommendation.title: Restore bounded supervisor logs
recommendation.body: Adopt a current-main design that writes the approved supervisor streams to the current log family and rotates only those streams with documented upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The original PR timeline routed launchd review to this account, though direct ownership history remains unconfirmed.
